data: Fragments of a hymn honouring Apollo and the Nymphs(?)
Three fragments of white marble, of which two join but the third is distinct. All are broken on all sides. Fragment 1 is H 7.8 cm x W 5 cm x D 2.7; fragment 2 is H 9.2 cm x W 8.5
Very fine to fine-grained, homogeneous, white marble, likely Docimian, Hymettan. Digital microscopy: homeoblastic fabric (identification based on pXRF, digital microscopy)
Found in 1873 on the site of Akrai in the course of surface survey, on the same occasion as IG XIV.214
Observed on display but not formally autopsied
Photo J. Prag, courtesy of  Museo Archeologico Regionale Antonino Salinas, Palermo
Partially reopened following extensive restoration work. Comprehensive collection of archaeological material, predominantly from the West of the island, with an important Etruscan collection.
Centre of Palermo, Piazza Olivella 24, 90100 - Palermo
